$comment: steading on the Strata driver (RFC 0027): headless, driven through Strata's drive channel, no X server. A driven steading writes only the new colony's slot in the session's data directory and never autosaves or saves on exit. No probe yet: screenshot-only.
name: steading-strata
title: steading
description: a colony simulation on Strata: settlers gather, build huts and try to last; you designate work and plan huts from a map view or a free-fly camera (Strata driver: headless; --clock stepped repeats frame for frame)

requires: an OpenUSD prebuilt (see the steading README)

cheats: Do not pass --headless, --ticks or --mods unless your goal says so.

smoke.description: Let the colony run, speed it up, then fly the camera over it, with screenshots

goals.goal: Keep a new colony alive for its first season as a player who has never seen the game; note every moment of confusion.
